note: The four per-paper changes of Pilot 3, applied on top of the run setups of data/seed_papers.json (which are not edited). These settings were chosen after Pilot 2's failures were seen, so Pilot 3 measures the settings, not the papers (docs/PILOT_3.md section 1). A paper that is not listed runs exactly as in Pilot 2.

paper_002.reason: The notebook imports lightgbm, which the repository's requirements.txt does not list. Unpinned: pip picks the newest release with a wheel for Python 3.8; the installed version is recorded in the run report.

paper_003.reason: The paper's own code caches a preprocessed file inside its data directory (data/california_housing/). A writable per-run copy of the data lets it write there without touching the host cache.

paper_004.reason: The run was still finding new best epochs (about 107 s per epoch) when the 3600 s limit of the run phase ended it; the config trains until 16 epochs without improvement (patience = 16, n_epochs = inf). Four hours is a choice, not an estimate of the needed time. The build and install phases keep 3600 s.

paper_005.reason: The run was killed by the 6 GiB memory limit at 76 of 540 grid-search steps. 12 GiB fits in the 15.5 GiB that Docker Desktop has on the owner's machine. It is a choice, not a measured need.
